summary: The strip is mostly static: the bird sits cropped at the top-left edge and barely moves across 15.96 to 16.20, with no pops or flicker, but the bird is badly framed and the shot's idea isn't readable.

faults.what: The sparrow, the subject of the shot, is jammed in the top-left corner with its head cut off by the frame edge. The fence and leaves take up most of the picture, so the subject is unclear and the look-at-us moment isn't visible.
faults.fix: Reframe or shift the camera so the whole bird, head included, sits inside the frame with room to turn.

faults.what: From 15.96 to 16.20 the bird is almost frozen, with only a slight head and body drift. There is no clear pose change and no tail flick starting, so it reads as a mushy hold.
faults.fix: Hold a clear look-at-camera pose, then add a quick tail flick with anticipation before the hop.
